classes.STABLE_SUPPORTIVE: The intervention direction is reproducibly supportive across the required contexts for every checkpoint in the replication window.
classes.CONTEXT_DEPENDENT: For a CORE_5 contributor, FULL_8 and CORE_5 intervention directions reproducibly disagree across every checkpoint in the replication window.
classes.STABLE_ADVERSE: The intervention direction is reproducibly adverse across the required contexts for every checkpoint in the replication window.
classes.UNRESOLVED: Fewer than three checkpoints, seed disagreement, mixed or indeterminate direction, or checkpoint-to-checkpoint instability.

law: JANUS MAY LEARN A REPRODUCIBLE INTERVENTION PROFILE OF ITS ORGANS ONLY AFTER MULTI-SEED AND MULTI-CHECKPOINT REPLICATION; THE RESULT REMAINS DIAGNOSTIC EVIDENCE AND NEVER SELF-GRANTS AUTHORITY OR MEMBERSHIP CHANGES.
